title: The arrival court
text: A shaded gravel court and a single frangipani tree. You leave the car, the road noise fades, and the first thing you hear is the sea.

title: The long veranda
text: A sixty-metre colonnade runs the length of the main house, its deep roof throwing a cool band of shade across polished cement floors.

title: Courtyards and light
text: Open courtyards bring light and rain into the heart of every building. Through the day, sun and shadow move across lime-washed walls like a slow clock.

title: The water garden
text: Still pools step down through the garden towards the bay, catching reflections of palms and sky before the land gives way to the sea.

title: Honest materials
text: Handmade clay roof tiles, reclaimed teak, lime plaster and local granite: materials that weather gracefully and belong to the coast.
